method.count: Distinct systems with verified native component, headless primitive or documented composition; conservative lower bound for each normalized option. Area is not in the denominator. Apple guidance, internal-only components and adjacent jobs are excluded.
method.native: system_catalogue retains source-native axes and named structural/interaction alternatives. API enum inventories are scoped to the linked component or part and are not a promise that every prop belongs on one root.
method.area: yes = documented equivalent; partial = some anatomy/state exists but full contract does not; not-found = no equivalent found in the cited starting manifest/spec/API; owner-decision = consciously excluded or scope decision; not-applicable = different job.
method.options: options is the normalized decision index. Native spellings remain in system_catalogue so different systems are not forced into false one-to-one value matches.
method.limits: No screenshots, logged-in products, measurements, hidden paid examples or inferred runtime verification. Open-ended CSS values and general native DOM props are not enumerated. Not found is bounded by cited search surfaces.

area.today: Count/dot; semantic tones; processing; border; four-corner placement; circle/rectangle overlap; compact/invisible. Presence has its own statuses and sizes. Standalone mark is named; attached mark is decorative. Count capping, show-zero policy, finite/nonnegative normalization and reduced-motion handling are documented in later spec sections.
area.gaps: No ribbon or inline-label component, or nine-position placement grid. The spec intentionally excludes arbitrary color/radius and freeform labels.
area.decision: Owner chose four corner placements and distinct count/activity/presence roles.
